_note: Mirefen gear (Expansion.md §8 budget: stats 0.55 x ilvl x Qa x slot, DPS x0.72/0.79, ArmorValue), quest items and fen junk.

items.name: Drowning Cord
items.description: Knotted reed-rope tied to a river stone, hung with frog-bone charms. Somebody wanted that lantern to stay down.

items.name: Lump of Fen-Glass
items.description: Green glass from a broken lantern, polished smooth by mireling thumbs. They collect it the way magpies collect spoons.

items.name: Wisp-Glow
items.description: A drop of light that kept glowing after the wisp stopped. It is warm, and it wriggles if you look at it.

items.name: Lowlantern Post-Lamp
items.description: One of Obi's new lamps: fen-glass, wisp-glow and a stubborn little wick. Hang it on a post and it will stay lit.

items.name: Crocolisk Tail
items.description: Heavy, scaly, and, according to Hettie, the best soup meat in the fen. Hettie is the only one who says this.

items.name: Fen Truffle
items.description: A knobbly blue truffle from under a giant toadstool. It smells like rain on a cellar door.

items.name: Gubbagulp's Pearl
items.description: A river-pearl the size of a plum, given in friendship, or taken in a fight. Either way it is warm from the chief's crown.

items.name: The Undertow Pearl
items.description: The pearl from the Tidewitch's staff. Inside it, very small and very far away, lanterns are still going down.

items.name: Croc-Hide Jerkin
items.description: Bo's own spare, cut from a crocolisk that bit the wrong fisherman. It still smells a little of pond.

items.name: Wader's Mail Boots
items.description: Mail to the knee and tar on the seams. Your feet will be dry. Your feet will be the only dry thing in Mirefen.

items.name: Cord of Net-Floats
items.description: Cork floats on a braided cord, worn by Lowlantern fishers for luck. Bo swears it works. Bo has nine fingers.

items.name: Glassblower's Gloves
items.description: Scorched at the fingertips. Obi says a good lanternwright never feels the heat. Obi has a lot of scars.

items.name: Lantern-Hook Mace
items.description: An iron lantern-hook on a heavy haft. It hangs lamps and, in a pinch, knocks things down from where they hang.

items.name: Ring of Wisp-Glass
items.description: A band of green fen-glass with a fleck of wisp-glow sealed inside. It blinks when you're about to do something unwise.

items.name: Lamplighter's Long-Staff
items.description: A long ash staff with a hook for hanging lamps on high posts. The hook glows, faintly, out of habit.

items.name: Post-Keeper's Belt
items.description: A mail belt with loops for a wick-knife, a tinderbox and a spare lamp. Obi made it for himself; it was always too big.

items.name: Wickman's Wraps
items.description: Leather bracers stained with lamp oil, the old wickmen's badge of trade.

items.name: Lily-Pad Cap
items.description: A wide hat of woven reeds with a lily pad sewn to the crown. It is very fashionable. The Duke has one too.

items.name: Puddle-Jumpers
items.description: Supple leather boots that make a very satisfying sound in puddles. Lily tested them thoroughly.

items.name: The Duke's Hop
items.description: A green glass ring Lily found in a frog's pond. She says it makes you jump higher. She is about eight.

items.name: Heronguard Greaves
items.description: River-blue mail greaves with a heron worked on each knee. Corwin's spare pair, carried out of Skyreach twelve years ago and never worn since.

items.name: Barrow-Warden's Cloak
items.description: A grey cloak the sextons of the Low Bell wore on their rounds. It keeps off rain, mist and, they said, the worst of the dark.

items.name: Sexton's Handbell
items.description: A little bronze handbell from the Low Bell's chapel. Ring it and the fen goes quiet for a heartbeat, listening.

items.name: Pearl of Listening
items.description: A mireling oracle's pearl on a kelp cord. Hold it to your ear and you can hear the fen thinking.

items.name: Conch-Shell Buckler
items.description: A great spiral conch backed with driftwood. Mireling-made, so it is a little small, and very, very sturdy.

items.name: Reedwoven Leggings
items.description: Leather trousers reinforced with tightly braided reed. Mirelings make them for visitors who keep falling in.

items.name: Reeve's Seal
items.description: Lowlantern's old seal ring: a lantern over three wavy lines. Tamsin has a spare. Tamsin has a spare of everything.

items.name: Croaking-Stone Hauberk
items.description: Mail rings dyed pond-green, with a little carved stone frog on the collar for luck.

items.name: Frog-Silk Robe
items.description: Not actually frog. Mireling silk, spun from something in the reeds nobody wants to describe. Beautiful, though.

items.name: Hettie's Ladle
items.description: A long copper ladle, bent in two places from 'disagreements'. Somehow it improves magic. Hettie says it's the stock.

items.name: Stew-Stained Breeches
items.description: Comfortable cloth trousers with a long and honourable history of soup.

items.name: Chowder-Keeper's Belt
items.description: A wide leather belt with a hook for a pot and a loop for a spoon. Every adventurer should be so prepared.

items.name: Hagthorn Dagger
items.description: A black thorn as long as your hand, bound to a bone grip. The coven used them to cut lantern cords.

items.name: Coven-Cord Sash
items.description: Woven from the cords the hags used to drown lanterns. Turned to a better use, it holds a robe up very well.

items.name: Reedcloak Spaulders
items.description: Leather spaulders thatched with dry reed, the way the coven wears them, but without the frogs.

items.name: Mantle of the Last Verse
items.description: A tide-singer's shawl of fen-grey wool, embroidered with every verse of the sending song. The last one is stitched in gold.

items.name: Reedrunner Spaulders
items.description: Light leather pauldrons in Lowlantern green, worn by the fen's runners who carry news between the stilt villages.

items.name: Lowlantern Pauldrons
items.description: Mail shoulders with a small brass lantern riveted to each. They glint at night, which the fen folk find very reassuring.

items.name: Gnasher's Tooth
items.description: One of Old Gnasher's front teeth, as long as a knife and twice as mean, bound to a whalebone grip.

items.name: Gubbagulp's River-Crown
items.description: A crown of river-pearls strung on gold lantern wire. It was sized for a frog, but it stretches.

items.name: The Bellringer's Mallet
items.description: The sexton's bell-mallet, green bronze on a black oak haft. Every swing sounds like a funeral.

items.name: Auntie Gall's Crook
items.description: A gnarled crook with a cage of lime marsh-light swinging from the hook. It hums a little tune when lanterns are near.

items.name: The Cauldron-Lantern
items.description: Auntie Gall's lantern, with her brew drained and a good honest flame put in instead. It still smells of soup.

items.name: Reed Mantle of the Coven
items.description: A long cloak of dry, rustling reed. Wearing it, you can stand still in the fen and simply not be there.

items.name: Mireling Pearl-Charm
items.description: A gift of the Croaking Stones: a river-pearl in a cage of carved bone. Mirelings give them only to friends of the tribe.

items.name: Soggy Boot
items.description: One boot, left foot, full of fen. There is a small fish living in it. It seems happy.

items.name: Very Pretty Pebble
items.description: Polished by a mireling for what must have been weeks. It is, genuinely, a very pretty pebble.

items.name: Rusted Lantern Ring
items.description: The iron ring from a drowned lantern's hook. The fen folk will buy these back, a little sadly.

items.name: Crocolisk Tooth
items.description: Crocolisks grow new teeth all their lives. This means there is always another one coming.

items.name: Pinch of Wisp-Dust
items.description: Glittering dust that drifts upward if you let go of it. Keep the bag closed.

items.name: Scrap of Bog-Linen
items.description: Grave-cloth, peat-brown and very old. It smells like the inside of a barrow, because it is.

items.name: Frog-Bone Charm
items.description: A coven charm with the whisper worn out of it. It looks less frightening than it used to, and a little lonely.

items.name: Hollow-Touched Fang
items.description: Violet at the root, like a bruise. It is cold, and stays cold in your hand.

items.name: Dried Eel Skin
items.description: A mireling delicacy, or a mireling shoelace. Possibly both, at different times.
